predictions.articleTitle: Imabari vs Jubilo Iwata Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Depleted Hosts Hold Steady?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Draw / Away Win alongside Under 2.5 goals as Jubilo Iwata's disciplined second-half execution meets an Imabari side struggling for open-play scoring.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win led by Jubilo Iwata's 50.4% Poisson win baseline and 0:2 / 1:1 scoreline convergence (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 total goals driven by Imabari's 0.31 decayed goals-for average and Iwata's 0.69 decayed goals-against rate over five games (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
1:1 draw contingency covering Iwata's 12.5% away clean-sheet rate and Imabari's 4-to-0 set-piece goal edge (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Depleted Imabari defense faces unbeaten Jubilo Iwata without right-back Rei Umeki.

spf.comment: Covers Jubilo Iwata's favoured 0:2 victory script and the 1:1 road stalemate because Iwata's 37.5% away win rate and 12.5% away clean-sheet rate make a single away-win call overly exposed.

over_under.comment: Poisson totals lean 51.4% Under 2.5 at a 2.62 combined lambda, reinforced by Imabari's 0.31 decayed goals-for average and Iwata's 0.69 decayed concession rate.

score.comment: 0:2 captures Iwata's away scoring consistency against a weakened 2.00-GA/gm defense, while 1:1 reflects the 11.9% Poisson modal scoreline and Iwata's recent draw pattern.

goals.comment: Two goals (25.0% baseline probability) aligns directly with 0:2 and 1:1, while three goals (21.8%) covers the 1:2 branch if Imabari convert from a set play.

bqc.comment: Imabari have never led at half-time at home (0/7) and Iwata draw half of their away first halves before converting 57.1% of overall level intervals into wins, leaving Draw-Draw as the natural second-half fork.
